legend.FIXED: Implemented and verified. Tracker verdict DONE or MET.
legend.BUILT: Implemented, not yet certified by a full release run. Tracker verdict PARTIAL, BUILT or IN PROGRESS — the code landed, the suite that would prove it has not run.
legend.OPEN: Confirmed, not started. Tracker verdict TODO, or a defect nobody marked closed.
legend.DECISION: Blocked on an owner decision or an owner action. Tracker verdict BLOCKED or DEFERRED, or a TODO the tracker marks as the owner's.
legend.CLEARED: Not applicable — the premise was false, or the item is counted against another row. Tracker verdict N/A.
